full_judgment: 2. Facts leading to the issuance of the Rule are inter alia that the petitioners as plaintiffs instituted the Title Suit No. 437 of 2000 before the learned Joint District Judge, 2nd Court, Dhaka for declaration of title and also for declaration that the suit property is not a vested property of the Government. The plaintiffs claimed that 54 acres land from the CS Plot No. 636 appertaining to CS Khatian No. 270 in Mouja Vakurta belonged to Mon Mohon Das and Shema Dashi and SA Khatian was duly prepared in their names. Mon Mohon Das died leaving a son, Behari Lal Das and Shema Dashi died leaving sisters, son Kishore Lal Das and some lands were recorded in the name of Keshob Lal Das. RS Khatian was prepared in the name of Keshob Lal Das. Thereafter Keshob Lal Das sold out 54 decimal lands to Md Moslem Uddin on 1-1-1980 who mutated his name and paid rent to the Government. After that Moslem Uddin sold all their lands to the plaintiffs. The plaintiffs being owner have been possessing the said lands peacefully.
